use_data_objects_spec.key_comment:
Controls which objects to load from the schema:
If [bold blue]prefer[/bold blue]: Load all objects from the database_schema. Use object specifications from data_objects_spec[] if they exist, otherwise use default specs from load_attributes.
If [bold blue]strict[/bold blue]: Load only objects specified in data_objects_spec[]. If any objects are specified in data_objects_spec[], their configurations will be used. [bold red]Warning:[/bold red] If use_data_objects_spec='strict' and data_objects_spec[] is empty, no objects will be loaded.

flow_mode.key_comment:
Controls the execution flow:
If [bold blue]object[/bold blue] (default): Extract and load objects one by one. Supports parallel processing with max_workers.
If [bold blue]dump[/bold blue]: Extract all objects first, then load all objects (sequential processing).

max_workers.key_comment: Maximum number of worker threads for parallel processing when flow_mode is 'object'. Set to 1 for sequential processing. Higher values enable parallel processing of multiple objects.

header.key_comment: Specifies whether the file contains a header line with the names of each column in the file.

columns_delimiter.key_comment: The character delimiting individual cells in delimited data files (CSV/TSV/TXT). Common values: ',' for CSV, '\t' for TSV, '|' for pipe-delimited, ';' for semicolon-delimited. File format is determined by this delimiter, not by file extension.

columns_quote.key_comment: Choose the quote character for CSV columns: double (""), single ('), or none. The default is double quote.

type_autodetection.key_comment: Controls automatic data type detection when CSV/TSV/TXT is used as source. If true, PyArrow will automatically infer column types (int, float, date, etc.) from the data. If false, all columns will be read as strings. Default is true.

null_string.key_comment: String representation of NULL values in CSV files. Common values: empty string (""), "NULL", "\N". Used when reading CSV files to properly identify null values. Default is empty string.

force_null.key_comment: If true, forces PostgreSQL to treat zero-length strings as NULL for all columns during COPY operations. This helps prevent type errors when loading data with missing values. Default is false.

object_name.key_comment: Specifies a unique data_object name. It can be a table name for database table or folder name for file export/import.

destination_object_name.key_comment: Optional! Specifies destination_object_name only if you want it to be different from source_object_name.

recreate_destination_object.key_comment: If this parameter is true, the destination object (or table) will be rebuilt. If false, the object/table will be created if it does not exists.

cleanup_linebreak_in_fields.key_comment: Setting this parameter to true will clean up a line break in all fields. This works, currently for MySQL extraction, the idea is to extend it to other sources in the future.

exclude_columns.key_comment: Specifies a comma-separated list of columns to exclude. Leave empty to include all columns.

object_source_dir.key_comment: Relevant to files upload only, e.g. csv/parquet/json as a source. Complementary to source_dir parameter. Logic: If source_dir is empty, object_source_dir must be an absolute path. If source_dir is set and object_source_dir is set, final path = source_dir + / + object_source_dir. If object_source_dir is not set but source_dir is, final path = source_dir + / + object_name.

file_names.key_comment: Relevant to files upload only, e.g. csv as a source. Specifies a comma-separated list of file names to upload or leave blank for all files inside object_source_dir

load_batch_size.key_comment: Specifies batch size for incremental load. It's not supported yet.

column_for_incremental_load.key_comment: Incremental load column. It's not supported yet.
